result.summary: Reworked lib/letflow/design/iss0923-catalog-delete-blocks-on-pinned-instances.md (design only, no code, no commit). (1) Section 6 D-E rewritten from real code: Engine.create/2 -> start_instance/6 (engine.ex:532-589) does R = PinResolver.resolve with pin_lookup/2 (engine.ex:1278-1281) -> PinLookup.catalog_lookup/1 (pin_lookup.ex:63-73, plain Repo.get(Entry), :not_found for missing and :RETIRED), then S = create_snapshot/3 (own committed txn, :1318), then P = persist/14 (projection commit); no enclosing txn, no lock. Interleaving 1 (R before delete commit, P after guard 3) -> pinned instance on deleted service -> ERROR at next pinned resolution; interleaving 2 (delete commits before R) -> create fails at start with pin-lookup not_found, no snapshot/instance written. Options costed: FOR UPDATE in delete alone is useless (plain read does not block); FOR SHARE in PinLookup is released at statement end unless R..P is wrapped in one transaction or re-validated in persist/14 -- an engine hot-path change outside owned modules; advisory locks need the same. Decision: accept, document, no lock, retire-first advised (RETIRED refused by PinLookup at start; pins keep resolving), engine closure recorded as follow-up in section 12; section 9(e) @doc wording and D-E table row made consistent. (2) AC-6 refs corrected to service_catalog_test.exs:384-385 (+ :392-396, :400-412 success); :471 noted as update_scope test; AC-11/section 7 concurrent test ref corrected to :427-453. (3) Ordering: section 2.1/3.1 now specify query all tenants (no early exit), per-tenant LIMIT cap+1, concatenate, sort ascending, take 50; list_registrations/0 order (Repo.all, no ORDER BY, tenant_provisioning.ex:274-276) declared irrelevant. (4) Index wording fixed (index lives on service_catalog_versions, migration 20260921000004:91-93; idx_proj_status partial :49-53). (5) AC-8 seam fixed: direct insert of 51 minimal instance_projections + instance_definition_snapshots rows (plus one shared process_definitions row because of the snapshot definition_id FK), no production accessor. (6) Section 8 item 5 added: req373 design doc lines ~350-363 stale delete/1 contract is a doc-update item. Verified by re-reading engine.ex:445-589, pin_lookup.ex, service_catalog.ex:860-969, instance_projection/snapshot schemas; no mix run needed (design-only).
